current.text: He is recovering from a torn ACL and will not be ready to start the season. Yahoo lists him as out with a knee injury.
Experts expect him back in January. Christmas is the earliest return, and one expert also says it could be February.
Experts expect limited minutes after his return, and they expect him to sit out back-to-backs.
Golden State has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.
Golden State is reportedly treating this season as a gap year.
The team is worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans, so this could be a throwaway season.
Draft him only after round 12, as a stash in an injury slot. Drop him once you need that slot.
His return will cut into the value of the other Warriors wings.

durable.text: His game relies on IQ, cutting, physicality and drawing free throws, not on explosiveness.
He makes few threes for a forward.

note: Both sites give him 0 USD of value (Yahoo rank 154, ESPN rank 214), and the experts say not before round 12. In our 12-round draft, that puts him outside the draft pool, far below the 22 USD our league paid last season. If you have a spare IL slot, a 1 USD stash could make sense, since his ESPN projection still holds up per game (FT% on 7.4 attempts, 1.4 steals, 5.1 assists, and he fits punt 3PM). Otherwise, watch his rehab news in December and January, his minutes limit and how often he sits back-to-backs, then pick him up from waivers when he is close to returning.
